C1276.title: White House Email Spoofing Incident
C1276.summary: In 2015, attackers sent emails appearing to originate from the White House, containing malicious links that directed victims to a fake Google login page to steal Google account credentials. The phishing scheme used the domain 'accounts-google.com' to mimic Google's legitimate site.

references.title: A Review of the 'Email Gate' Incident During the U.S. Election Year - National Information Center
